centreAddress: Premier Business Park, 52 Broomhill Rd, Tallaght, D24 VE8E
directions: From Tallaght Driving Test Centre in Premier Business Park take the 1st left to continue along Broomhill Road for about 400 metres
At the end of the road turn right onto Airton Road and follow it for roughly 460 metres
Turn left onto Belgard Road and go straight through the roundabout
Turn right onto Old Blessington Road, then take the next right into Belgard Square East
